description: Llama 3.3 is Meta's latest open-weights large language model, offering 70B parameters with 128K context length. It provides performance comparable to Llama 3.1 405B on many tasks while being significantly more efficient to deploy.

trainingData.description: Trained on approximately 15 trillion tokens from publicly available sources.

trainingProcedure: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). Training used 7.0M GPU hours on H100-80GB.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Matches Llama 3.1 405B on many benchmarks while using only 70B parameters. Strong performance on coding, math, and multilingual tasks.

knownLimitations: May generate incorrect or misleading information
May exhibit biases present in training data

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias with mitigation applied during training.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: RLHF alignment and safety tuning applied.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local deployment for privacy-sensitive applications.

licenseTerms: Separate license required for >700M monthly active users

requirements.deployment: Local deployment, cloud deployment, or through inference providers

hardware.70B: High-end GPU required, ~140GB VRAM for full precision, can use quantized versions for consumer hardware
